name: Kuo-Toa Mumbler
tactics: The kuo-toa mumbler waits for the fight to come to it, confident that its maddening mumbles protects it from melee attackers. It uses strange eon’s syllable to blind a foe, then makes a vicious spear attack in preparation for unleashing its terrifying revelation.

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

traits.name: Maddening Mumbles
traits.details: Any creature without the aquatic keyword that enters the aura or starts its turn there takes 10 psychic damage. A creature can take this damage only once per turn.

traits.name: Aquatic
traits.details: The mumbler can breathe underwater. In aquatic combat, it gains a +2 bonus to attack rolls against nonaquatic creatures.

auras.name: Maddening Mumbles
auras.details: Any creature without the aquatic keyword that enters the aura or starts its turn there takes 10 psychic damage. A creature can take this damage only once per turn.

powers.name: Slick Maneuver
powers.requirements: The mumbler must be adjacent to an enemy.

effect.description: The mumbler shifts up to 3 squares to another square adjacent to that enemy.
Close burst 10 (allies in the burst); each target gains a +2 power bonus to Fortitude and Will, and the mumbler gains a +2 power bonus to all defenses, until the end of the mumbler’s next turn.
